items.name: Columbus, Nebraska prefillable-syringe (BD Neopak) capacity investment
items.claim: BD announced a $110 million investment to expand production of prefillable syringes for biologic and GLP-1 drug delivery, bringing BD Neopak Glass Prefillable Syringe production to Columbus, Nebraska and creating approximately 120 new jobs.
items.source_excerpt: BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) (NYSE: BDX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced a $110 million investment to expand its production of prefillable syringes, helping accelerate biologic and GLP-1 drug delivery and supporting pharmaceutical reshoring in the U.S. This investment will bring BD Neopak™ Glass Prefillable Syringe production to Columbus, Nebraska, creating approximately 120 new jobs

items.name: BD Neopak XtraFlow Glass Prefillable Syringe commercial release
items.claim: BD commercially released the BD Neopak XtraFlow Glass Prefillable Syringe, the latest capacity expansion of the BD Neopak platform for biologic therapies.
items.source_excerpt: BD has expanded usability of this platform with the commercial release of the BD Neopak™ XtraFlow™ Glass Prefillable Syringe.

notes: data/edgar/docs/BDX.json is an 8-K cover with no exhibit body text and disclosed no backlog/RPO figure; not cited. Both items are BD's own press releases naming dated, GLP-1-relevant prefillable-syringe capacity investments.
